Full suite green: 517/517. I fixed source only and left the tests alone. Nothing is committed.

Two commits broke it:

- **`958d3ae` (thousands separators in `formatMoney`):** the cents part used `padEnd`, so 5 cents rendered as `.50`. It now uses `padStart` in `src/money.js`, and the comma grouping stays. This fixed the `formatMoney` tests and the `PIN-03` render row.
- **`4188e9a` (per-line discount groundwork):** `taxable` was set to `subtotal`, so tax ignored order-level codes like `SPRING10`. It is now `subtotal - discount` in `src/invoice.js`. The line-discount support, `lineDiscounts` and the empty-list check are untouched. This fixed the `CA-ON SPRING10` invoice and render tests.
